title: Aurora Luxury Vertical Panel Bed – Deep-Fill Tall Headboard Bed Frame
descriptionHtml:
The Aurora Luxury Vertical Panel Bed is our tallest vertical panel headboard, upgraded with a thicker foam fill and heavier-weight fabric options for a more substantial feel to the touch as well as to the eye. It is the deeper-filled version of the standard Aurora Vertical Panel Bed.

Key features

  • Extra-tall vertical panel headboard and matching footboard
  • Thicker foam fill
  • Heavier-weight fabric options
  • Handcrafted in the UK
  • Solid timber frame with a slatted base for support and ventilation
  • Optional ottoman gas-lift storage

Sizes and prices

Single (3FT) £384.99; Small Double (4FT) £439.99; Double (4FT6) £454.99; King (5FT) £493.99; Super King (6FT) £519.99. Not sure which size you need? See our bed sizes guide.

Materials & build

Built on a solid wood frame and upholstered by hand in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire. Fabrics: Plush Velvet, Naples, Chenille, Linen and Crushed Velvet. Choose from a wide range of colours. Free fabric swatches let you check colours at home.

Mattress

Takes a standard UK mattress in the size you choose. Browse our mattresses, such as the 3000 Pocket Sprung Mattress, to complete the bed.

Delivery, returns & warranty

Free delivery applies across Great Britain, by our own team, typically within 3-5 working days. Northern Ireland is £90. Changed your mind? You can return it free within 14 days if it is unused and unassembled in its original packaging, and we collect it. If anything arrives faulty we will replace it or refund you in full. Every bed has a 5-year frame warranty. Pay in instalments with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout. Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon-Fri, 9am-6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

Frequently asked questions

What makes the Luxury edition different from the standard Aurora Vertical Panel Bed?

The Luxury edition has a thicker foam fill and heavier-weight fabric options. The standard Aurora Vertical Panel Bed is the baseline design.

Can I add ottoman storage?

Optional ottoman gas-lift storage is available. Call 07417 439197 to confirm the options for this design.

When will it arrive?

Delivery is free across Great Britain and usually takes 3-5 working days; Northern Ireland is £90.

Can I return it if it is not right?

Yes. Returns are free within 14 days if it is unused and unassembled in its original packaging, and faulty items are replaced or refunded in full.
